content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Christian Video songs's PostChristian Video songs is feeling wonderful.January 15 · Shared with PublicFamous Actor and Martial Artist Chuck Norris grew up in a Christian home, but he has said his faith became real during a life threatening crisis. When his wife suffered a major medical emergency while pregnant with twins, success, influence, and connections suddenly meant nothing.In that moment, Norris said he realized there was only one place to turn. Despite wealth, fame, and friendships with powerful leaders, he discovered that none of it could provide peace or control the outcome. What remained was prayer and total dependence on Jesus.His testimony reflects a familiar theme in Christian belief: faith is often forged not in comfort, but in desperation. For Norris, the crisis didn’t create belief it activated it, anchoring his life not in achievement, but in trust.Source/Credit: Chuck Norris interviews and public testimoniesShared for informational/Educational purpose only#jesuslovesyou #GodWillMakeAWay #Godwillprovide #christianvideosongs #GodWillTakeCareOfYou #chucknorrisAll reactions:7114 sharesLikeComment
